intro: Designed to respond to your posture and pace, the Camo Gaming Chair blends bold aesthetics with intelligent adjustability—so every session feels supported, controlled, and effortlessly comfortable.

features.title: Durable synthetic leather with textured accents
features.text: Camo uses charcoal and tan synthetic leather on key surfaces, delivering a sleek, wipe-clean finish that stands up to daily use. Knitted black fabric inserts keep high-contact areas breathable, so you get the premium look of leather without the stuffy feel during long gaming or work sessions.

features.title: Recline-ready for gaming and downtime
features.text: A CTS multi-lock tilt mechanism lets the seat and back move in sync, with a maximum recline of about 108 degrees for relaxed viewing or mid-session breaks. This coordinated movement maintains a balanced posture instead of collapsing your lower back.

features.title: Targeted comfort with adjustable lumbar
features.text: An adjustable lumbar element allows you to dial in precisely how much lower-back support you need, based on your height and sitting style. It encourages a healthier spine position for long stretches of gaming, study, or WFH, so you feel less stiffness when you finally get up.

features.title: Adaptive support with adjustable headrest
features.text: The adjustable headrest can be moved to match your neck and head height, supporting you whether you sit upright in focus mode or recline slightly to relax. This reduces the temptation to crane your neck forward, improving posture and comfort, especially with large monitors or multi-screen setups.

features.title: 3D armrests that move with you
features.text: Adjustable 3D armrests let you position support exactly where your forearms naturally rest on the desk or controller. This customisation helps relieve pressure on shoulders and wrists, improving both comfort and control during aim-heavy sessions or long typing marathons.

features.title: High backrest that envelops your frame
features.text: A high backrest engulfs your torso, offering continuous support from lower back to shoulders. Combined with an adaptive seat, it keeps you centred and stable even during intense play.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
